name: yf_forex_history
description:
Daily exchange-rate history for one currency pair from Yahoo Finance.
Returns: {pair, data_points (total days), rates: the first (oldest) 100 days, each {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits}}; with periods longer than about 5 months the most recent days are cut off.
Inputs (* required): pair* (EURUSD, GBPJPY or EURUSD=X; "=X" is appended when missing; default EURUSD=X); period (1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, ...; default 3mo).
Other sources: openbb_forex_historical (date range), av_forex_daily; current rate: av_forex_rate. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"pair": "USDINR", "period": "1mo"}

pair.description: Currency pair, e.g. EURUSD or EURUSD=X (=X is appended if missing)
